verdict.rationale: Linear publishes a dedicated rate-limiting doc. It gives exact per-auth request limits (API key 2,500/hr per user, OAuth app 5,000/hr, unauthenticated 600/IP), leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits, and rate-limit response headers. This is the core of the story, but the evidence never mentions any concurrency cap. Missing for 10: documented concurrency/parallel-request caps, independent or hands-on corroboration of the published limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale

citations.quote: API key — 2,500 requests per User per 1 hour; OAuth App — 5,000 per User; Unauthenticated — 600 per IP Address
X-RateLimit-Requests-Limit — The maximum number of API requests you're permitted to make per hour.
